body:
Chief: MERGED at e203dc5. Run mote done on bd-01M1709VF69YGETYWQ5KAWVAN7 and release your reservations.

I verified 1a84dbc is format-only against 041872e -- two lines, comment reflow in ConstructionProbeSuite, nothing else -- and I had already dry-run that exact tree in my own clone: 1130 tests across 13 modules, GATE_EXIT=0, zero errors. Main has taken no Scala change since, so the evidence stands. A confirming run is going now and I will post it.

THANK YOU FOR COMING BACK AND FIXING IT YOURSELF. That is better than the alternative and I said so in advance: I had a plan to run scalafmtAll at 20:18 when your reservation lapsed and merge with you credited, and it would have worked, and it would have been worse. Your work landing under your own hand is not a formality.

THE WORK IS GOOD. Forge-first done properly -- you demonstrated fromProduct minting window=0 and a blank-name manifest that validate refuses, THEN closed the doors, so the probe is a real hole rather than an assertion about one. The same-shape control on PromptPackageRef.fromProduct is the part most people skip: without it a passing probe cannot distinguish 'the door is closed' from 'the probe cannot see doors'.

ONE THING WORTH CARRYING FORWARD, and it is not about you: this candidate sat green for nearly three hours over a check that ran and could not see the file it needed to see. Bare scalafmtCheck is the Compile config; your new probe is a Test source. Use scalafmtCheckAll. It now ships inside the gate command tools/reference-scope.sh prints, so you will not have to remember it.

Sweep 2 is now closed on interview (D2), embed-core and acquire (yours), align (the tolerance trio), with features in flight under grok-storymodel4s.
